=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_inject_token_into_url` (lines 3041-3053) and `_resolve_origin_url` (lines 3077-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using command-scoped authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, clone `.git/config`, and Git errors, violating the credential-hygiene contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` (lines 567-585) and `memory_ensure_branch` (lines 140-180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` and command-scoped authentication were removed while remote URLs interpolate `GH_PAT`/`GH_TOKEN` and branch operations use bare Git commands.
  WHY: Tokens leak through clone/push arguments and unauthenticated operations fail with `persist-credentials: false`, losing memory persistence.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted `is_sensitive_target_path` (was lines 158-170), `normalize_path` (lines 241-245), and `emit_context` main loop (lines 568-579) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection, path limits, and normalization are removed, and raw caller paths are read.
  WHY: `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.aws/credentials` can enter model context, creating a credential-exfiltration regression.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 50, 210-215, 661-666 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase bypasses the model-provider broker and invokes codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` and the real `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostics reach a write-capable model with the upstream credential instead of the documented brokered read-only boundary.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: file now ends at line 140; deleted `model_provider_broker_*` functions | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Broker helper functions were deleted while unchanged scripts and tests still invoke them.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, review, editor, conflict, validation, audit, planning, triage, and orchestration phases fail with command-not-found before model execution.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` (was after `gh_retry`, ~line 496) and callers `review_rb_judge.sh:2014, 2413-2414` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while guarded review-blocked push paths still call it.
  WHY: Fix-branch and baseline publishing fail with command-not-found or unauthenticated `git push`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `review_blocked_*` helpers (was lines 975-1376) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval, digest, successor, and consumed-marker helpers were deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke them.
  WHY: Terminal merge, follow-up, and reissue flows cannot mint, verify, publish, or consume approval envelopes.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST projection at line 769 and GraphQL projection at lines 833-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment projections omit `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked logic cannot authenticate producer markers, identify trusted approvals, or deduplicate consumed markers.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: argument parser at lines 95-113 and hardcoded `base_url` at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and the provider endpoint is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Existing broker callers fail with an unknown-argument error; accepting and ignoring the option would bypass the loopback broker.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, `is_sensitive_target_path` (was lines 152-170) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Exported targeted-context symbols were deleted while tests still import and exercise them.
  WHY: `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fails during pytest collection with `ImportError`.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` at lines 404-407; `_kill_child_group_if_running` at lines 439-444; `_forward_signal` at lines 451-454; idle SIGKILL gate at line 560 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Kill paths return when the tracked sudo wrapper has exited without signalling surviving isolated-group members or scheduling SIGKILL.
  WHY: `nobody`-owned editor descendants remain alive after the wrapper exits, defeating the process-group isolation fix.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` at lines 292-331; watchdog calls at lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing metadata, unavailable helpers, or failed privileged signalling fall back to killing only the runner-owned guard, while callers suppress failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The isolated process group can survive while workspace ownership is restored.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` max-bytes branch at lines 536-545 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` emits headers and a disabled marker instead of returning the previous empty string.
  WHY: The zero-byte disable contract is broken and existing tests expecting empty output fail.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: missing-file branch at lines 549-552 and lines 576-579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file markers do not count toward `used_bytes`, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: An unbounded list of nonexistent paths can produce arbitrarily large prompt output despite `max_bytes`.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-68 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Generated-file cleanup checks index membership instead of HEAD membership, restores only the worktree, and removes the index-only fallback.
  WHY: Index-only or staged generated files can make `git restore --source=HEAD` fail or contaminate the implementation commit.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 585-586 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The final survivor check runs only when `guard_term_sent_at is not None`.
  WHY: A clean wrapper exit can leave a daemonized isolated descendant undetected.
- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh: lines 138-145 and `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` at lines 292-331 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A successful TERM signal can return before TERM-resistant members are confirmed stopped, and the config-failure path can skip the kill sequence.
  WHY: Cleanup may chown the workspace while isolated editor processes remain.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 286-289 and 394-403 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Metadata publication and privileged signalling have unbounded failure and convergence races.
  WHY: Metadata failure can leave an untracked editor, while group-empty and new-member races can be treated as successful termination.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 486-490 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A kill timer can race the selector loop after `signal_failure` causes wrapper exit.
  WHY: The timer may operate on a closing child handle and obscure the original failure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
